hypotheses.V1_source_value_code_is_lexically_recurr: Same lexical-pair source current-V deltas have median cosine at least 0.20 against disjoint FineWeb references for both FineWeb and TinyStories queries.
hypotheses.V2_routed_value_code_is_lexically_recurr: Same lexical-pair frozen-route current-V writes have median cosine at least 0.20 against disjoint FineWeb references for both query corpora.
hypotheses.V3_routed_code_identifies_lexical_pair: Nearest-reference lexical-pair accuracy of the routed code is at least 50% on both query corpora.
hypotheses.V4_source_value_abstracts_semantic_famil: Excluding identical lexical pairs, same-family source-value cosine exceeds different-family cosine by at least 0.05 on both query corpora.
hypotheses.V5_routed_value_abstracts_semantic_famil: Excluding identical lexical pairs, same-family routed-value cosine exceeds different-family cosine by at least 0.05 on both query corpora.
hypotheses.V6_routing_improves_semantic_abstraction: The routed-value family gap exceeds the source-value family gap by at least 0.05 on both query corpora.
